about.description:
PyEPR provides Python bindings for the ENVISAT Product Reader C API
(EPR API) for reading satellite data from ENVISAT ESA (European Space
Agency) mission.
PyEPR, as well as the EPR API for C, supports ENVISAT MERIS, AATSR
Level 1B and Level 2 and also ASAR data products. It provides access to
the data either on a geophysical (decoded, ready-to-use pixel samples)
or on a raw data layer. The raw data access makes it possible to read
any data field contained in a product file.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: pyepr
  version: "1.3.1"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 3b41469005075eb2318003facc331c1045f78d7f72a3d4c7a0c70ebf3935619b

build:
  number: 2
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - python
    - setuptools >=77.0.3
    - pip
    - packaging
    - numpy >=2
    - cython >=3.1
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - epr
      pip_check: true
  - files:
      source:
        - tests/
    requirements:
      run:
        - packaging
        - pip
        - pooch
        - pytest
    script:
      - python -m pytest tests

about:
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file:
    - LICENSE.txt
  summary: Python ENVISAT Product Reader API
  description: |
    PyEPR provides Python bindings for the ENVISAT Product Reader C API
    (EPR API) for reading satellite data from ENVISAT ESA (European Space
    Agency) mission.
    PyEPR, as well as the EPR API for C, supports ENVISAT MERIS, AATSR
    Level 1B and Level 2 and also ASAR data products. It provides access to
    the data either on a geophysical (decoded, ready-to-use pixel samples)
    or on a raw data layer. The raw data access makes it possible to read
    any data field contained in a product file.
  homepage: https://avalentino.github.com/pyepr
  repository: https://github.com/avalentino/pyepr
  documentation: https://avalentino.github.io/pyepr/html/index.html

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - avalentino
